MathJax 3.2.1 - local browser bundle for JCain Engineering

Bundled component:
  tex-svg-full.js

Purpose:
  Render TeX/LaTeX mathematics to SVG without depending on an external CDN.

Upstream project:
  MathJax
  https://www.mathjax.org/

License:
  Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE in this directory.

This site uses the full TeX-to-SVG component so common TeX extensions are
available from the local bundle without requiring additional MathJax files.
